details:
For the past several months or so, I've experienced an issue while playing VRChat where my cloning would be on despite having the "Auto Disable Cloning" option enabled and Cloning set to off at all times. This tends to happen at random and will show up mainly when going to public instances or even private instances with friends.

This leads to situations where my cloning will be on without me realizing and people can clone an avatar off of me without them asking me about it. This occurs often enough to where I've developed a habit of turning my cloning on and then back off as a precaution to prevent people from randomly cloning avatars that I wear.

I should mention that I play on PCVR, but this also happens on Quest. It's basically as if the "Auto Disable Cloning" toggle doesn't do what it's intended to do or even does the opposite and turns on cloning instead of automatically turning it off. To summarize, what this looks like is that cloning will appear off in the settings menu, auto disable cloning will be on, yet when entering an instance, cloning will be on for others which allows them to clone and/or favorite an avatar in any instance.
title: Cloning being enabled while "Auto Disable" is on
